about_the_game:
After the catastrophic collapse of civilization, the world has fallen into chaos. Infected streets, ruined cities, and mysterious quarantine zones are all that remain of the old world. Silence reigns, broken only by the moans of the dead. There’s nowhere to run. There’s only one thing left to do: fight.

Another Day To Die is a cooperative top-down survival shooter for 1–4 players. You’re not a soldier — you’re just an ordinary person: a firefighter, mechanic, medic, or office worker. You have no military training. No superpowers. Just your wits, teamwork, and the will to make it through the nightmare. Together.

  • 4-Player Co-op
    Survive together with friends or face the nightmare alone. Clear infected zones, cover each other’s backs, share supplies — and make tough choices when someone gets left behind.

  • Endless Hordes of the Infected
    Get ready for relentless tension. Face slow, rotting walkers and fast, aggressive mutants. Every mission is a desperate fight for every inch of ground.

  • Unstable, Ever-Changing Maps
    No mission is ever the same. The layout of buildings, choke points, loot, and enemy spawns changes with every playthrough. You'll never fight on the same map twice. The environment evolves, forcing you to adapt, explore, and improvise to survive.

  • Makeshift Weapons and Rare Finds
    From wooden bats to flamethrowers — anything can keep you alive. Scavenge resources, upgrade your gear, and use whatever you can get your hands on.

  • Survivor Progression
    Develop your character, unlock specializations, and tailor your playstyle. Be a frontline fighter, support specialist, or clever engineer — the choice is yours.

  • Tactical Freedom
    Block entrances, barricade narrow passages, cut off escape routes — or lure the undead into traps. Each map is a deadly sandbox filled with danger from every direction.

  • Unique Missions and Events
    Every operation is more than just shooting. Rescue survivors, repair vital equipment, defend supplies — and prevent the infection from spreading.

  • Solo Play Mode
    Go it alone if you must — but surviving by yourself is a much harder task.

You're not a soldier. You're not a hero. You're just trying to live one more day.

Can you survive Another Day To Die?

  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-6600
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia GTX 980
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 20 GB available space

  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-7700K
  • Memory: 8 MB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia RTX 1050
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 20 GB available space
